about: The Workbench icons of the AtomicTanks drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/atanks.png) is the game's own icon (atanks.png, 48 x 48) scaled to 128 x 128, GPL-2 or later like the game. AtomicTanks-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, AtomicTanks.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-AtomicTanks, COPYING.txt, Controls and Licences.txt; Data.info is the icon of the Data and User drawers.
